submitted.rationale: Index 2 (Bi0.22 Cu0.30 V0.48) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 4.47e-5 A. Its XRD shows monoclinic BiVO4 (Q≈1.34 and 2.03) plus a second phase at Q≈1.746, probably a Cu vanadate. The near-single-phase BiVO4-rich film (index 7) gave only 1.24e-6 A. Index 4 has the same two phases but lower Bi and gave 3.73e-5 A, so the best point appears to sit near index 2.

rejected.reason: Near-single-phase BiVO4 region; measured 1.24e-6 A, about 36x lower than index 2
Same phases as index 2 but less Bi; measured 3.73e-5 A, lower than index 2
Loses the Q=1.746 phase, which is present in the best films, and gains other phases (Q 1.48, 2.24); not measured
Cu-rich region with a different set of phases (no BiVO4); likely a poor photoanode; not measured
